title: (Re)Discover KTEQ
body:
After 55 years of broadcasting from the Black Hills, KTEQ is launching something new.

## What's Happening

We're in the middle of a top-to-bottom refresh â new studio equipment, new programming tools, a new website (you're looking at it), and a renewed commitment to the freeform radio philosophy that's defined this station since 1971.

## Why Now

KTEQ has always been scrappy. We've gone silent and come back more than once. We've moved frequencies, rebuilt studios, and weathered every challenge a student-run station can face. In 2025, we were inducted into the South Dakota Rock & Roll Hall of Fame â a recognition that this little station has meant something to people.

Now it's time to build for the next 55 years.

## What's Coming

- **Studio renovation** through summer 2026
- **Grand reopening** during M-Week, September 25, 2026
- **New programming** with better scheduling and music rotation tools
- **Fundraising campaign** to support equipment and operations

Stay tuned. We're just getting started.
excerpt: 55 years in, KTEQ is launching a top-to-bottom refresh: new studio, new tools, same spirit.
author: KTEQ Staff
